en.title: Andrew Garfield Officially Denies Spider-Man Return in Avengers: Doomsday
en.summary: The actor has firmly shut down persistent rumors about reprising his iconic role. Despite past instances of playing coy, Garfield is making his stance crystal clear on potential future appearances.
en.body:
For months, the internet has been abuzz with speculation: would **Andrew Garfield** don the red and blue suit again for **Marvel**'s upcoming blockbuster, **Avengers: Doomsday**? The question has been a persistent one, fueled by fan desires and the actor's own nuanced history with the role. However, **Garfield** himself has now delivered a resounding and unequivocal answer, aiming to put these rumors to rest once and for all.

Speaking at the premiere of his historical action drama **The Uprising**, **Garfield** was direct when asked about his potential involvement in the massive superhero ensemble. He stated, "I don’t want to be disingenuous." This sentiment echoes previous comments where he has actively dismissed the possibility of his Spider-Man swinging into **Avengers: Doomsday**. The actor has emphasized his desire for clarity, especially given his past experiences with the press regarding his appearance in **Spider-Man: No Way Home**, where he famously kept his involvement a secret.

## The Rumor Mill Churns

The persistent rumors are understandable. **Andrew Garfield** portrayed Peter Parker in **The Amazing Spider-Man** films, and his return alongside **Tobey Maguire** in **Spider-Man: No Way Home** was a massive crowd-pleasing moment. Fans, naturally, have been eager to see if this collaboration could extend to other major **Marvel** projects. However, **Garfield** has been quite firm in his recent statements, even going as far as to say "No, unequivocally fucking no" when pressed on the matter in a separate interview. He wants to be very clear that neither he nor **Tobey Maguire** will be reprising their iterations of Spider-Man in **Avengers: Doomsday**.

## What This Means for the Fans

For the passionate **Spider-Man** fanbase, this news might come as a disappointment. The hope of seeing multiple cinematic Spider-Men unite once again in a grand **Avengers** narrative is a powerful one. **Garfield**’s past performance in **No Way Home** was widely praised, and many felt it was a vindication of his take on the character. While **Garfield** has made it clear he has not seen **Spider-Man: Brand New Day** or **The Odyssey** (referring to **Spider-Man: No Way Home** in a playful manner), his focus appears to be on new projects. His firm denial, however, suggests that any future **Spider-Man** appearances would likely be in a new capacity or a completely different iteration, rather than a direct continuation of his previous arcs within the **MCU**'s grand ensemble films.

## What's Next

**Andrew Garfield** is currently promoting **The Uprising** and is expected to star in upcoming projects that are yet to be fully detailed. While his **Spider-Man** days in the **MCU** appear to be firmly behind him, his career continues to move forward with diverse and compelling roles.
